args.body:
Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to address CVE-2026-31337 (high severity: unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays). 2.9.4 is the first fixed release in the 2.x line.

CI: passed (run ci-0001).
